title: Body Released for Burial
body: Habochur Eliyahu Abba Shaul Z”L, 20, of Bnei Brak, was released from the forensic institute after drowning in the Yarkon River. His body was recovered Sunday and will be buried tonight.

title: Volunteer Killed in Traffic Accident
body: United Hatzalah volunteer Nechemia "Chemi" Erlanger z”l, 34, was killed in a devastating traffic accident on the first night of Chanukah, leaving behind his wife and five young orphaned children.
